name: NumberInput
purpose: Nullable numeric entry with locale-aware display, native form participation and optional shared step buttons.
description: Numeric entry with Base UI NumberField. Empty values are null; the displayed text is locale-aware while the form submits the raw number. Arrow Up/Down step, Shift uses largeStep, Alt uses smallStep, and Home/End use defined bounds. Steppers remain available to pointer/touch users and are omitted from the Tab sequence. Use Field for help and host-owned validation errors. Currency formatting is not financial arithmetic.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled numeric value. Omitted or null starts empty.

props.name: hiddenInputRef
props.description: Ref to Base UI's form-associated numeric input; the forwarded ref targets the visible input.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible standalone label. Inside Field, omit this to use its label.

props.name: showSteppers
props.description: Show pointer/touch step buttons. Keyboard stepping remains available when hidden.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled numeric value; null represents an empty field.

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description:
When true, direct text entry may be outside the `min`/`max` range without clamping,
so native range underflow/overflow validation can occur.
Step-based interactions (keyboard arrows, buttons, wheel, scrub) still clamp.

props.name: allowWheelScrub
props.description:
Whether to allow the user to scrub the input value with the mouse wheel while focused and
hovering over the input.

props.name: format
props.description: Options to format the input value.

props.name: largeStep
props.description:
The large step value of the input element when incrementing while the shift key is held.
Snaps to multiples of this value when `snapOnStep` is enabled.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The locale of the input element.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the input element.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the input element.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: number | null, eventDetails: NumberFieldRoot.ChangeEventDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Callback fired when the number value changes.

The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the change:
- `'input-change'` for parseable typing or programmatic text updates
- `'input-clear'` when the field becomes empty
- `'input-blur'` when formatting (and clamping, if enabled) occurs on blur
- `'input-paste'` for paste interactions
- `'keyboard'` for arrow-key/Home/End stepping (typing digits uses `'input-change'`/`'input-clear'`)
- `'increment-press'` / `'decrement-press'` for button presses on the increment and decrement controls
- `'wheel'` for wheel-based scrubbing
- `'scrub'` for scrub area drags

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.type: ((value: number | null, eventDetails: NumberFieldRoot.CommitEventDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Callback function that is fired when the value is committed.
It runs later than `onValueChange`, when:
- The input is blurred after typing a value.
- The pointer is released after scrubbing or pressing the increment/decrement buttons.

It runs simultaneously with `onValueChange` when interacting with the keyboard or the
mouse wheel.

**Warning**: This is a generic event not a change event.

props.name: smallStep
props.description:
The small step value of the input element when incrementing while the alt key is held.
Snaps to multiples of this value when `snapOnStep` is enabled.

props.name: snapOnStep
props.description: Whether the value should snap to the nearest step when incrementing or decrementing.

props.name: step
props.description:
Amount to increment and decrement with the buttons and arrow keys, or to scrub with pointer movement in the scrub area.
To always enable step validation on form submission, specify the `min` prop explicitly in conjunction with this prop.
Specify `step="any"` to always disable step validation; interactive stepping then uses a base amount of `1`, while the alt and shift keys still step by `smallStep` and `largeStep`.

guidance.overview: Nullable numeric entry with locale-aware display, native form participation and optional shared step buttons.
usage: Use for quantities; use TextInput for identifiers where exact text and leading zeroes matter.
Control value with number or null and accept changes in onValueChange. Omitted or null defaultValue starts empty; defaultValue is initialization, not a reset command.
Arrow Up/Down use step, Shift uses largeStep, Alt uses smallStep, and Home/End use defined bounds. Set showSteppers=false to omit pointer buttons while retaining keyboard entry.
Preserve onValueChange/onValueCommitted details when wrapping the component. A commit describes the interaction, not validation or persistence.
Set name and optionally form to submit the raw number once. Locale formatting is visual/editing behavior; formatting precision can round committed values.
accessibility: Use a visible standalone label, enclosing Field, or accessible name. Field help/error text is associated automatically, alongside explicit descriptions.
Read-only input remains focusable; disabled input is unavailable. Steppers are outside the Tab sequence and retain primitive pointer/touch behavior.
Localize decrementLabel/incrementLabel as needed. The primitive exposes a text input with a number-field role description; do not add unsupported spinbutton semantics.
intent: invalid and Field.error reflect host-owned validation; allowOutOfRange lets direct entry reach native bounds validation without creating an application error message.
Currency/percent formatting does not calculate money, conversions or arbitrary precision values. Supply finite bounds, positive steps and valid Intl options.
context: Compose inside Field and FormSection for allocation, quantity and numeric settings forms. The component does not own saving or persistence.
Use an explicit locale for predictable server/client formatting. Choose a data representation and validation policy appropriate to the domain.
